mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE existing_component_id = #{existingComponentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND operation_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time ASC
SELECT * FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND operation_status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND operation_status = 'FAILED' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ddh_operations_management SET operation_status = #{operationStatus}, operation_result = #{operationResult}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_ddh_operations_management SET operation_status = #{operationStatus}, end_time = #{endTime}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE t_ddh_operations_management SET operation_status = #{operationStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT operation_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_type = 'SERVICE_CONTROL' THEN 1 END) AS service_control_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_type = 'HEALTH_CHECK' THEN 1 END) AS health_check_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_type = 'LOG_MANAGEMENT' THEN 1 END) AS log_management_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_type = 'CONFIG_SYNC' THEN 1 END) AS config_sync_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN priority >= 8 THEN 1 END) AS high_priority_count FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} GROUP BY operation_status

SELECT operation_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) AS success_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 END) AS running_count, AVG(duration_ms) AS avg_duration_ms, MAX(duration_ms) AS max_duration_ms, MIN(duration_ms) AS min_duration_ms FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY operation_type

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS operation_date, operation_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) AS success_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate FROM t_ddh_operations_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time), operation_type ORDER BY DATE(create_time) DESC
